title.en: Meaning and features of business environment

hook.en: A tea stall owner cannot control rain, the price of milk, or a new café opening next door, yet each one changes his sales. These outside forces are his business environment.
hook.kn: ಚಹಾ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನಿಗೆ ಮಳೆ, ಹಾಲಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಹೊಸ ಕೆಫೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗದು; ಆದರೂ ಅವು ಅವನ ಮಾರಾಟ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇವೇ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರ.

objectives.en: Explain the features of business environment

narration.en: A tea stall owner cannot control rain, the price of milk, or a new café opening next door, yet each one changes his sales. These outside forces are his business environment.
narration.kn: ಚಹಾ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನಿಗೆ ಮಳೆ, ಹಾಲಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಹೊಸ ಕೆಫೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗದು; ಆದರೂ ಅವು ಅವನ ಮಾರಾಟ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇವೇ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರ.

body.en: Business environment is the sum total of all individuals, institutions and other forces that are outside the control of a business enterprise but that may affect its performance. Specific forces such as customers, competitors, suppliers and investors affect a firm directly; general forces such as economic, social, political, legal and technological conditions affect all firms indirectly.

points.en: Specific forces: customers, competitors, suppliers, investors
General forces: economic, social, political, legal, technological

narration.en: Business environment is the sum total of all individuals, institutions and other forces that are outside the control of a business enterprise but that may affect its performance. Specific forces such as customers, competitors, suppliers and investors affect a firm directly; general forces such as economic, social, political, legal and technological conditions affect all firms indirectly.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರತಾದ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುವ ಎಲ್ಲ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು, ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ. ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳೆಂಬ ಎರಡು ವಿಧ.

title.en: On the board: specific and general forces

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Put the firm at the centre. Everything around it is the environment.
The inner ring holds specific forces that touch the firm directly.
The outer area holds general forces that affect every firm.
The firm cannot control any of these; it can only understand and adapt.

body.en: Business environment is the totality of external forces; it has specific and general forces; its parts are inter-related; it is dynamic and keeps changing; it is uncertain; it is complex; and it is relative, differing from place to place.

narration.en: Business environment is the totality of external forces; it has specific and general forces; its parts are inter-related; it is dynamic and keeps changing; it is uncertain; it is complex; and it is relative, differing from place to place.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರ ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ; ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ, ಚಲನಶೀಲ, ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತ, ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ.

body.en: Totality, Specific and general, Inter-related, Dynamic, Uncertain, Complex, Relative.

narration.en: Totality, Specific and general, Inter-related, Dynamic, Uncertain, Complex, Relative.

mnemonic.en: "To See If Dad Understands Comic Relief" (T S I D U C R)

problem.en: After a sudden ban on single-use plastic in Karnataka, a Mysuru sweet shop had to switch to paper boxes, which raised its costs and changed customer habits. Which features of business environment does this show?

steps.en: The ban came suddenly and could not be predicted: uncertainty.
A legal change also changed costs and customer habits: inter-relatedness.
Conditions keep changing over time: dynamic nature.

answer.en: Uncertainty, inter-relatedness and dynamic nature of business environment.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಬೆಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Business environment is the total of outside forces that affect a firm.
points.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುವ ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ.

points.en: Specific forces act directly; general forces act on all firms.
points.kn: ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳು ನೇರವಾಗಿ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: It is dynamic, uncertain, complex, inter-related and relative.
points.kn: ಅದು ಚಲನಶೀಲ, ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತ, ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ, ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ.

homework.en: Explain any four features of business environment with examples.

narration.en: Recap. Business environment is the total of outside forces that affect a firm. Specific forces act directly; general forces act on all firms. It is dynamic, uncertain, complex, inter-related and relative.
